Blended return of a stock and bond portfolio

Source: R/portfolio_return.R
portfolio_return.Rd

Weights the stock and bond returns by the share of the portfolio held in stocks. From the Asset allocation chapter.

Usage

portfolio_return(stock_pct, stock_return, bond_return)

Arguments

stock_pct

Share of the portfolio in stocks, as a decimal (0.8 is 80%). The rest is in bonds.

stock_return

Stock return for the period, as a decimal.

bond_return

Bond return for the period, as a decimal.

Value

A numeric vector of portfolio returns, as decimals.

See also

Other asset allocation: rebalance_amount()

Examples

# 100/0, 80/20, and 60/40 in an average year and a bad year
splits <- c(1, 0.8, 0.6)
portfolio_return(splits, stock_return = 0.10, bond_return = 0.04)
#> [1] 0.100 0.088 0.076
portfolio_return(splits, stock_return = -0.40, bond_return = 0)
#> [1] -0.40 -0.32 -0.24
